name: 🤡Quiet or Die!
desc:
Welcome to a game where silence keeps you alive… and sound gets you killed.
One player becomes the terrifying Blind Seeker – a killer who can’t see, but can hear everything. The rest must hide, survive, and most importantly… stay quiet. Every footstep, whisper, or bump could give away your location.
